title: Wenchi Crater Lake & Tourism Village Overnight Trip
description: Join us for an incredible two-day, one-night weekend getaway to Wenchi, recognized as one of the world's best tourism villages! Experience scenic hiking, a boat trip, horse riding, natural hot springs, therapeutic mud baths, and swimming. Wrap up the evening with a cozy campfire and a delicious barbecue dinner.
meetingPoint: Mexico Square, Addis Ababa @ Wabe Shebele
itinerary: Meet at Mexico (Wabi Shebele) at 06:00 AM and depart for Wenchi.
Arrive at Wenchi, begin the hiking journey, and enjoy a scenic boat trip and horse riding.
Set up camp, followed by a evening campfire and barbecue dinner.
Day 2: Experience the natural hot spring waters, mud bath, and swimming.
Enjoy lunch and relax before heading back to Addis Ababa.
safetyNotes: This is an active group trip involving water and outdoor trekking. Please follow the instructions of the local guide at all times, wear life jackets during the boat trip, and take caution near the hot springs.

title: Overnight Trip to Doho Lodge & Benuna Village with Ermja Hiking
description: Join us for an exciting weekend getaway featuring an overnight trip to Doho Lodge & Benuna village paired with Ermja Hiking! Experience a scenic trek, explore Awash Park and its waterfall, and unwind with swimming in a natural hot spring pool and hot spring water baths. The package features a cozy evening campfire with a barbecue dinner and tent accommodations.
includes: Swimming in Natural Hot Spring Pool
itinerary: Meet at Megenagn - Zefmesh mall at 06:00 AM and depart.
Arrive at Awash Park to view the waterfall and begin the hiking experience.
Head to Benuna Village and Doho Lodge to set up camp.
Enjoy an evening campfire and barbecue dinner.
Day 2: Relax and swim in the natural hot spring pool and take hot spring baths.
Enjoy meals and wrap up photography before returning back to Addis Ababa.
safetyNotes: This is an active outdoor and hiking trip. Please follow instructions from the local guide, stay hydrated, and practice caution when swimming in the hot spring pools.

title: Camping Trip To Langano
description: Join us for an amazing two-day, one-night camping getaway to Lake Langano! Explore the breathtaking scenery of Shalla National Park, visit Lake Shalla and Lake Zeway, and enjoy an active hiking experience. The trip includes cozy tent camping, a warm evening campfire, and a delicious barbecue dinner by the lakeside.
whatToBring: Warm clothes for the evening campfire
itinerary: Meet at Mexico - Wabi Shebele at 06:00 AM and depart from Addis Ababa.
Stop by Lake Zeway for scenic views on the way.
Head to Shalla National Park and explore Lake Shalla.
Arrive at Lake Langano, set up camp, and enjoy hiking.
Unwind with an evening lakeside campfire and barbecue dinner.
Day 2: Relax by the lake, enjoy meals, and take final photos before returning to Addis Ababa.
safetyNotes: This trip involves outdoor camping and walking near deep crater lakes. Please follow the safety guidance of the local guide and take care near the water edges.

title: Blue Nile Falls Weekend
destination: Bahir Dar and Blue Nile Falls
description: A weekend route built around waterfall views, relaxed lakeside time, easy walking, and warm group travel rhythm.
itinerary: Travel from Addis Ababa toward Bahir Dar.
Settle in and enjoy a relaxed lakeside evening.
Walk the Blue Nile Falls route with the guide.
Return after breakfast and a final viewpoint stop.
safetyNotes: Waterfall paths may be slippery in wet weather. Follow the guide at viewpoints and bridges.
